key_capabilities.note: Scenarios and complications are stated inconsistently: the home page lists 'Mimic real life with multiple scenarios and complications' under 'Today', while the platform page lists 'Scenarios and complications' under 'Coming soon', so it is not listed as a current feature. Also 'Coming soon': 'Suite of procedures from Fundamentals to Surgery' and 'Collaborative platform'. Listed under 'Tommorow' (spelled so) on the home page: 'AI Rehearsal', 'Create your own case', 'Practice on the exact patient pathology'. A testimonial mentions ultrasound image quality and catheter steering.

value_proposition.value: Lets clinicians practise procedures safely in VR so they perform in reality, aiming to eliminate medical error and democratise healthcare training, and in future to act as an AI co-pilot for clinicians.
